issues.description: The frozen package contains no analysis datasets. Program Code.pdf names fulldatafinal, CmpnySentFraudFinal and Disfluencies_firm as inputs; available fields, periods, sample/exclusion history, access terms and compatibility are unverified.

Program Code.pdf supplies downstream statistical analyses and two in-program SAS temporary/deduplication datasets, but does not show how the three named analysis inputs or Stata variable acc_demean are produced from the historical Qualtrics responses.

Program Code.pdf interleaves SAS procedures and Stata reg commands in one PDF without executable-file boundaries, data-loading instructions, working paths, variable handoff or run order. The two lag uses are only in-program deduplication after sorting (by subject; by company and subject), not a documented rolling or annual history.
The frozen SAS startup probe failed with a TKELS extension initialization error. This leaves SAS and the required procedure environment unverified and does not establish an absent license.

review_notes: Program Code.pdf contains substantial author code despite having no standalone source extension and zero frozen static dependency edges; manual review identified SAS analysis, Stata regression snippets, and three separate named data inputs.

The supplied SAS lag() uses are preceded by sorts and create within-program deduplication outputs (fordescriptives and temp3343); the supplied code has no lead or rolling-window construction. No additional raw-history requirement was inferred.

No analysis_only scope is included because no compatible author-prepared analysis input is present or verified. The three author-named analysis datasets remain unresolved requirements; the historical Qualtrics origin is not treated as a new live participant-collection dependency.
The shared environment artifact was reused as supplied. SAS remains unverified after TKELS initialization failure; no license status is inferred.
